title: Insulin Fiasp Prediction
symptom: Fiasp has a different curve for prediction values; it starts quicker and may not last as long as Novolog. Users report that predictions are wrong with the actual insulin model, and the insulin action graph does not reflect the actual duration or peak time.
cause: The thread suggests that different insulins (like Fiasp) have different action curves, and the current model assumes a symmetrical curve with peak at half duration, which does not match Fiasp's early peak.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Users suggest adjusting the insulin duration setting in predictive settings to better match Fiasp's action, and one user proposes adding a field for peak time to create an asymmetrical triangle model.
evidence_quote: The main issue is that Fiasp is not a simmetrical curve, the peak is very erly compared to its duration. Reading the comments here i'll try to put the duration of fiasp to 1.67 h getting the peak at 50 min and check the predictions.
